maya: Heads-up — noticed ~12% of requests in the quota dashboard are being attributed to the proxy project when callers do SA key exchange. That inflates some teams' usage. Anyone else seen this?
ton y: Yup saw the blip last night. Happens when we drop the original origin header during proxy/impersonation.
maya: I think we should prefer 'origin_project' for quota attribution unless the exchange explicitly signals billing_transfer.
lia: Do we have a field today that survives exchange? IIRC we strip some headers in the auth-proxy.
samir: We currently set X-Caller-Project on entry, but the exchange flow mints a token and the downstream only sees the token subject (sa-123). We lose the calling project unless we propagate a signed header.
maya: Proposed minimal change: attach a signed origin header at auth handoff and plumb it through runtime routing so the quota sampler uses that tag. Example: 
```
X-Origin-Project: proj_abc123
X-Origin-Signature: sig_v1(base64)
```
This avoids tying quota to the minted SA identity by default.
lia: Signing is good for anti-spoof, but who verifies? runtime or auth-proxy?
ton y: runtime verifies signature using our key registry. cheap crypto check, 100k qps should be fine with async verify + cache.
samir: Concern: billing implications. If billing_transfer is requested by customer, we must let SA identity take over billing. Need opt-in flag in the token exchange response.
maya: Agreed. Plan: default = preserve origin_project for attribution; if exchange response contains claim billing_transfer=true then attribute to minted_sa_project.
ops-jen: ops note — changing attribution will change dashboards + alerts. We need migration audit mode first (both tags emitted), then flip.
maya: Exactly — rollout suggestion: 1) emit X-Origin-Project and X-Attribution-Fallback in headers and telemetry events (no change to quota engine), 2) run audit comparison for 48h, 3) enable attribution switch behind feature flag for canary orgs, 4) full roll after 7 days.
ton y: For telemetry, add event fields: attribution.origin_project, attribution.effective_project, attribution.reason. Keep them indexed.
samir: Also add a metric for 'attribution_mismatch' per org so we can surface teams affected.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: auth-proxy/propagate-origin v2 -> staging at 2024-07-12T03:20Z :rocket: (CI green)
lia: UX for console: need a callout on project usage page saying "some requests attributed differently due to exchange" with a link to audit logs.
maya: Good call. Also expose sampling traces for affected requests (sample_id header) so support can dig in.
ton y: Implementation caveat: caches keyed by effective_project will increase miss rate if we use origin_project instead. Might need a small warmup policy.
samir: Can we do a hybrid: route by effective_project for cache locality, but charge (quota) by origin_project? That keeps perf but fixes billing.
maya: That would be ideal. We'll prototype routing vs billing decoupling. Lia, can you mock console language for the callout and the feature flag UI?
lia: On it. I’ll drop a draft in #product later today.
ops-jen: When we flip the flag, alerting team — please add runbook step: revert flag if mismatch > 5% for > 2 hours.
maya: Thanks. I'll open a PR with header spec + telemetry schema and link it here.
deploy-bot: maya pushed branch origin-attribution-spec -> https://git.internal/r/redwood/auth-proxy/merge-requests/142
maya: PR up. PTAL and I'll start the audit job once merged. :thumbsup:
